question: Through whose grace has the determination of Kaula become known to the speaker?
premises: The knowledge concerns the determination of Kaula.
The cause stated is the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has known the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
